source_text: Caeterum probare est haereticorum et schismaticorum baptisma consentire in id quod illi baptizaverint. Neque enim potest pars illic inanis esse et pars praevalere. Si Baptizare potuit, potuit et Spiritum sanctum dare. Si autem Spiritum sanctum dare non potest, quia foris constitutus cum sancto Spiritu non est, nec baptizare venientem potest, quando et Baptisma unum sit, et Spiritus sanctus unus, et una Ecclesia a Christo Domino super Petrum origine unitatis et ratione fundata. Ita fit ut cum omnia apud illos inania et falsa sint, nihil eorum quae illi gesserint probari a nobis debeat. Quid enim potest ratum et firmum esse apud Deum quod illi faciunt quos Dominus hostes et adversarios suos dicit in Evangelio suo ponens: Qui non est mecum adversum me est; et qui non mecum colligit, spargit. Et beatus quoque apostolus Joannes mandata Domini et praecepta custodiens in epistola sua posuerit, dicens: Audistis quia antichristus venit. Nunc autem antichristi multi facti sunt. Unde cognoscimus quia novissima hora est. Ex nobis exierunt, sed non fuerunt ex nobis. Si enim fuissent ex nobis, mansissent utique nobiscum. Unde nos quoque colligere et considerare debemus an qui adversarii sunt Domini, et appellati sunt antichristi, possint dare gratiam Christi. Quare qui cum Domino sumus, et unitatem Domini tenemus et secundum ejus dignationem sacerdotium ejus in Ecclesia administramus, quaecumque adversarii ejus et antichisti faciunt repudiare et rejicere et pro profanis habere debemus, et eis qui de errore et pravitate venientes agnoscunt unius Ecclesiae veram fidem, dare illis per omnia divinae gratiae sacramenta et unitatis et fidei veritatem. Optamus vos, fratres charissimi, semper bene valere.
pass_a_gloss: Moreover, to approve the baptism of heretics and schismatics is to consent to what they have baptized. For neither can a part be empty and a part prevail there. If he could baptize, he could also give the Holy Spirit. But if he cannot give the Holy Spirit, because he is constituted outside with the Holy Spirit, he also cannot baptize one who comes, since both Baptism is one and the Holy Spirit is one and the Church is one, founded by Christ the Lord on Peter as the origin of unity and the reason for its foundation. Thus it happens that since all things among them are vain and false, none of the things they have done should be approved by us. For what can be ratified and firm with God, which they do, whom the Lord says are his enemies and adversaries in his Gospel, saying: He who is not with me is against me; and he who does not gather with me, scatters? And also the blessed apostle John, keeping the commands and precepts of the Lord, has said in his epistle: You have heard that antichrist is coming. Now many antichrists have been made. From which we recognize that it is the last hour. They went out from us, but they were not of us. For if they had been of us, they would certainly have remained with us. From which we also ought to gather and consider whether those who are adversaries of the Lord and are called antichrists can give the grace of Christ. Therefore, we who are with the Lord and hold the unity of the Lord and administer his priesthood in the Church according to his dignity, ought to repudiate and reject and consider as profane whatever his adversaries and antichrists do, and give to those who come from error and wickedness, recognizing the true faith of the one Church, the sacraments of divine grace and the truth of unity and faith. We wish you, dearest brothers, to always be well.

pass_b_english: To approve the baptism of heretics and schismatics would be to consent to what they have baptized. A part cannot be empty while another part prevails there. If he could baptize, he could also give the Holy Spirit. But if he cannot give the Holy Spirit, because he stands outside and is not with the Holy Spirit, then he cannot baptize the one who comes, since Baptism is one, the Holy Spirit is one, and the Church is one, founded by Christ the Lord on Peter as the origin of unity and the reason for its foundation (Matthew 12:30). It follows that, because all things among them are vain and false, none of the things they have done should be approved by us. What can be ratified and firm with God that they do, whom the Lord calls his enemies and adversaries in his Gospel, saying: "He who is not with me is against me, and he who does not gather with me scatters"? The blessed apostle John, keeping the commands and precepts of the Lord, has written in his epistle: "You have heard that antichrist is coming. Now many antichrists have been made. From this we recognize that it is the last hour. They went out from us, but they were not of us. For if they had been of us, they would certainly have remained with us" (1 John 2:18-19). From this we also ought to gather and consider whether those who are adversaries of the Lord and are called antichrists can give the grace of Christ. Therefore, we who are with the Lord and hold the unity of the Lord and administer his priesthood in the Church according to his dignity, ought to repudiate, reject, and consider as profane whatever his adversaries and antichrists do. And we ought to give the sacraments of divine grace and the truth of unity and faith to those who come from error and wickedness, recognizing the true faith of the one Church. We wish you, dearest brothers, to always be well.
